name: OSTI Research Agent
description: Searches the OSTI scientific papers and reports database for publications to answer specific research questions.

skills.name: Search Literature
skills.description: Search OSTI database for peer-reviewed publications, experimental data, and research findings to answer specific questions about material properties, operating parameters, or engineering phenomena
skills.usage_notes: Use when you need published experimental data, peer-reviewed research, or information not available in the material database. Long-running operation - reserve for questions requiring literature support
skills.output_format: JSON with answer, provenance (source papers), citations, and confidence assessment

question.description: Research question to answer (e.g., 'What is the creep rate of stainless steel 316 at 400C and 15MPa?', 'What operating temperature is safe for TRISO fuel?')
